FC.FeedingPath.Desc: Place down this path and slap down some carnivore feed to feed your favorite carnivore.
FC.CarnivoreFeed.Desc: A cruelty free feed for your carnivore friends, made with some of the most fortifide ingridents without the guilt of hurting another animal.
FC.WoodwindFish.Desc: A species of snipefish, the woodwind fish are hunters of zooplankton.
FC.UncleCrimson.Desc: Sometimes colloquially called the 'uncle crimsonfish' as it has been jokingly said to resemble the 'weird uncle' of the better known Gem Sea crimsonfish.
FC.SeaSnake.Desc: The Arcanian Sea Snake is the smallest member of the genus Arcanophis, and the only fully marine snake native to Arcania.
FC.GummigusFish.Desc: The gummigus is a nimble swimmer that prefers rocky deepwater environments.
FC.ShelledSquid.Desc: This peculiar squid is unique in that it appears to possess an external shell; however, this shell is in fact a calcitic eggcase.
FC.SpikedSeaHorse.Desc: This spikey back seahorse is know for it's poisonous spikes that line it's flexible spine.
FC.ArcaAxol.Desc: This Arcanian Axolotl is best known for it's sharp fangs and feisty attitude.
FC.BoneyHeadedGraveFish.Desc: This hard headed fish is believed to swim in waters that lead to the afterlife. It's newly Imported from Arcania.
FC.IficusFish.Desc: This fish is believed to bring good luck when caught. It's newly Imported from Arcania.
FC.DancerFish.Desc: While fast and graceful, this fish is one of the only fish that doesn't quite taste like fish. It's newly Imported from Arcania.
FC.RiverBedJelly.Desc: This jellyfish has adapted to live in deep fresh water. It's newly Imported from Arcania.
FC.GraveCrab.Desc: The grave crab is called its namesake due to its habit of robbing graves for food. It's newly Imported from Arcania.
FC.GulpFish.Desc: The gulp fish is a riverbed dwelling fish that feeds by opening its mouth wide and sucking in its prey. It's newly Imported from Arcania.
FC.LeechFish.Desc: The leechie fish is a river dwelling fish that can leap from the water and attach itself onto a host. It's uses it's many sharp teeth to bite into the flesh of animals in order to feed on their blood.
FC.SharkFish.Desc: The Minima Shark, lives primarily in fresh water. Unlike it's cousin, the requiem shark.This small shark speices has evovled to be no larger then a catfish.
FC.SwampFish.Desc: A small, voracious ambush predator, the arcanian frogfish is a species of reef anglerfish endemic to the island's coasts.
FC.PufferCousin.Desc: This fish can be usually found in the reefs of Arcania. Known for it's color, it's shiny white scales are desired for jewerly as they catch the moonslight perfectly and reflect it with a meserising sparkle.

FC.PlantShop.Mail.Title: Welcome to T.A.E
FC.PlantShop.Mail: Yaluu! We at the T.A.E. are excited to unveil our groundbreaking program! We are committed to empowering aspiring farmers across the globe by providing them access to our exclusive seed reserve. ^By strengthening agricultural connections between nations, we can cultivate hope and foster lasting peace. ^We firmly believe that bountiful, quality produce has the power to transform communities and build bridges. Join us on this vital journey and help us create a world where harmony thrives through the beauty of well-grown produce!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.00: Let's talk about animals! Here in Arcania, the wildlife is beautiful and worth the trip just to see them in person. However, a important rule of thumb is to look but never touch. While some of the creatures of the isles are docile, you're much more likely to run into a animal that wants to kill you. In fact, the fauna of the isles is so dangerous that the Arcanian people grouped up on the center island, Tuuwe Arcania, just to find safety from them. Many hundreds of years ago, the Arcanian people lived across all three sister islands. The creatures of the isles must be truly ferocious to drive people from their homes; in fact, there's not a village occupied anywhere but Tuuwe in modern times. Ain't that something! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.01: Let's talk marriage! Here in Arcania, a marriage proposal is nothing to smile about. It's a full process, starting with a complex courting system and ending with one heck of a argument! To begin the courting process, the proposer will bake something called an Adauula Sweet Twist. This sweetened bread is given to the person of interest first, and if it's accepted. The new couple to be will eat the bread together. Afterwards, the proposer will move into the family home of the proposee. There they will help the parents of their interest for a entire two months. Proving to their love interest's family that 'Hey! I'm marriage material!' After two months of integrating into the family, the parents will let the proposee know how they feel about the said proposer. With the family being in agreement, the two can marry! But it's not so simple; there's one last ceremony before the sacred candle lighting. The proposer will stand before the proposee and argue their case! That's right, they have to seal the deal with a interview-style, 'why do you want to marry me' question! Ain't that something! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.02: Let's talk about laws! Here in Arcania, it's illegal to hold ceremonies of any kind on the 13th of winter. This is because the 13th is the documented birthday for Arah; it was on the 13th hour of the 13th day of the coldest day that Arah came to life and greeted her mother! Holding ceremonies during this time can earn you a fine of 1000 Arcanian Coins, that's 500 coins in Ferngill currency! So remember, next winter 13, if you're holding a ceremony. You're technically breaking the law in Arcania. Ain't that something! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.03: Let's talk about the weather! Here in Arcania, the weather can get intensely dangerous. So dangerous that some villages are completely wiped off the face of the Isles. Hurricanes, Typhoons, Flooding, and more! The people of Arcania, though, have been developing safety measures for hundreds of years now. If you want to be safe from a storm, Arcania is the place to be. Underground tunnels, panic-cellars beneath public buildings, and even high-rise safe havens for when the water starts to rise. There is no a shortage of shelter here at the isles. In fact, Arcanian weather measures have been ranked the best in the world for over twenty years now. Ain't that something! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.04: Let's talk about foliage! Here in Arcania, there is a remarkably diverse variety of plant life growing all around the islands. All three of the sister islands are bursting at the seams with different species of plants! Some are naturally edible, some can save your life, and some can even heal wounds! There's even a flower so stinky, so disgusting that only one animal can stomach eating it! Ain't that something! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.05: Let's talk about religion! Here in Arcania, the people worship not one, not two but three goddesses! There's Liphum, the goddess of the sun and mother of Arah. Arah is the second Goddess, who is literally seen as the soul of our very planet! And the third is a child goddess named Auula, the goddess of youth.
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.06: Let's talk about food! Here in Arcania, food is the glue that holds their culture together. From religious practices to social ceremonies. Food always seems to be the centerpiece. Nurishment is culturally significant to the Arcanian people in a way that is spiritually driven. Even love is displayed through the giving of food. Even after war, the people of Arcania will give food to their beaten enemies, as a offering of peace and love. Ain't that something! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.07: Let's talk about civil war! Here in Arcania, civil war has been prominent in its history. Before the great merging, when the people of the Isles split up because of religious beliefs. The two sister islands, Suuwe and Ruual, were constantly fighting. With Tuuwe stuck in the middle as the referee. One side believed Liphum was the true goddess to worship, and the other believed Arah was the true goddess to worship. This difference led the people into bloodbath after bloodbath. It wasn't until the great flooding that the people of both sister locations gathered on Tuuwe. Which was on higher ground, sharing a night of peace in the face of destruction. A new age of religious unity was found. Tuuwe, the island of Auula, became a home for a family. A place to worship all three goddesses and a place for the Arcanian people to live happily among each other. Ain't that beautiful. Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.08: Let's talk about family dynamics! Here in Arcania, the dynamics of a family can be varied. But, generally speaking, family units typically fall into a matriarchal pyramid of sorts. At the top of the pyramid is the eldest woman. She is the one who makes the big choices, and usually her word is the law of the family. Beneath her is her life partner, who typically relies on said law to the rest of the family. The middle of the pyramid consists of women, whose power changes depending on their age. Usually, the older you are, the more power you have. At the bottom of the pyramid are those who are men, who tend to be ranked on the lowest scale for power. Which still begins from eldest to youngest. Ain't that something. Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.09: Let's talk about, the our galaxies birthday! There is a old legend, originating from Suuwe Arcania. That speaks about the birth of our galaxy. It is said, that there once was a god named Xenos, who would wander the universe searching for dying galaxies to eat. Within his belly, swirled the magic of that saturates all galaxies. Whenever he would eat a dying galaxy, whatever was left inside his gut would swirl and combine into something anew. After Xenos woud overeat, he would become sick and a new galaxy would come from him. Talk about nasty! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CulturalExchangeRadio.10: Let's talk about the season of love! Here in Arcania, the season of summer is the season of passion and love! Associated with the star Firious, the father of Auula and lover of Arah. Summer is the season for declaring your love for others and passionately seeking out reltionships. People will offer spiced drinks to Firious in a attempt to gain his favor.Talk about romantic! Well, that's it for today, folks. Remember to spread happiness today, and don't forget to stay shapely!
FC.CookingChannel.00: Sweet Joluu Swirl! I have a friend in a wonderful village called Yamay. She taught me that if you get Adauula Flour and one sliced up Joluu Spear. You can coat the Joluu Spear in the flour and can bake it. Then presto! You have a Sweet Joluu Swirl ready for eating!

FC.MeekSeed.Desc: While the bark is darker in color, the inside of the meek tree is bright yellow. This tree produces one of the harder varieties of woods. Use the seed to grow your very own meek tree.
FC.ReuuSeed.Desc: Once thought to be extinct. You can tap this tree for resin or keep it bare and harvest the Reuu Nuts from it. You can also cut it down for wood, but make sure to replant the seed!
FC.HeaviousSeed.Desc: Thought to be extinct, this Arcanian Ginkgo tree was discovered recently, growing and thriving on a remote southern island situated between Gotoro and Ferngill. Use the seed to grow your very own heavious tree.
FC.BuurkTreeSeed.Desc: A soft tree seed that can be eaten in recipes or ground. Use the seed to grow your very own buurk tree.

FC.ReuuNut.Desc: The Reuu nut is a very earthy and soft nut that is grown by the Reuu tree.

FC.MeekSap.Desc: A very sweet sap that works best in pastry recipes.

FC.StoneShroom.Desc: While its fungal cousins are soft and fluffy to the touch, this shroom has branched off into a species of mushroom that has developed a hard exterior shell similar to stone.
